description: Read retained captured console output as a compact tail of timestamps, levels and messages. Filter by minimum level or a case-insensitive message substring. Fatal JavaScript errors may be included when supported hooks captured them; post-crash availability is not guaranteed. Missing entries do not establish that no error occurred. Use get_snapshot for available full entry details. Needs configured console capture. Works on the free tier.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

level.description: Minimum level to include (severity threshold). e.g. 'warning' = warnings + errors. Default all.

pattern.description: Only entries whose message contains this substring (case-insensitive).

name: get_console
